description: 3HDM-S3 scalar decay observables at general delta, the CP-even Higgs-basis angle (delta = -psi, the residual 2x2 block angle; the draft's total angle is alpha = theta_v + delta). VV couplings, predicted delta per benchmark point, and LFV Higgs branching ratios (tau mu, tau e, e mu) against the CMS limits.  Quark Yukawas are not part of this build, so BRs use the measured SM-like total width.

conventions.delta: -psi with psi the residual CP-even 2x2 block angle; alpha = theta_v + delta. Scenario A is delta 0, B is pi/2, but |delta| < pi/4 always, so h_1 always carries the larger hVV coupling and B is a limit, not a reachable point.
conventions.lepton_yukawa_split: G_k read off the Lagrangian with all three VEVs symbolic (lfv.lepton_g_function). Supersedes the first version, whose sqrt3-typed-in M_l gave G_2 = 0 and a wrong Q_2 (h_0 couplings).
